name: Gaussian Extraction Algorithm
aliases: Gaussian Extraction Algorithm — Octree-Guided Geometry Sampling, Optimizing Geometry with GauPF
definition: Extracts discrete 3D Gaussian centers from the continuous GauPF using an octree-based progressive sampling and optimization strategy, similar to Marching Cubes for SDFs.
summary: The Gaussian Extraction Algorithm converts continuous Gaussian Splatting Functions into discrete 3D Gaussians using octree-guided sampling and gradient-based optimization.
